text:
nina: quick ping  I opened PR #4488 to tidy the quickstart: unify env var, add a Go example for users on the platform team, and fix a couple of broken links. can folks glance?

omar: thanks. which env var did you pick? we've got REDWOOD_KEY, API_TOKEN, etc.

nina: using REDWOOD_API_KEY as the single canonical name and a short migration note for LEGACY_TOKEN users.

lia: can you paste the Go snippet? want to check import path + response shape.

nina: sure, from the PR: 

```go
package main
import (
  "fmt"
  "os"
  "github.com/redwood/inference-go"
)
func main() {
  client := inference.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
  resp, _ := client.Generate("redwood-1", "hello quickstart")
  fmt.Println(resp.Output.Text) // Output has Text + Tokens + Meta
  client.Close()
}
```

omar: looks good. note: method returns (Response, error) in latest SDK, maybe add a quick error check in sample.

kevin: I reviewed links  private-deploy and key-rotation were 404s; I pasted corrected URLs in the PR comment. also suggest calling out minimum Go version (1.20).

lia: can we avoid streaming in the main quickstart? it confuses folk during the first deploy. add a short streaming appendix instead.

nina: agreed, removed streaming from the main flow and added a link to streaming appendix. added a one-line Docker build+run example for demos: `docker build -t quickstart . && docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY quickstart`.

omar: tiny nit: use `resp.Output.Text` not `resp.Output.Text()` (Go field vs method). also include `defer client.Close()` to be idiomatic.

kevin: can we add a troubleshooting bullet: 401 -> check env var + org allowlist? saves time during workshops.

nina: added a 3-bullet troubleshooting section and a short curl example to mint ephemeral tokens for workshop attendees.

docs-bot: PR #4488 labeled docs/quickstart and assigned to nina. claimed by kevin for links and omar for SDK verification.

nina: thanks all. I'll push the edits in 30m. planning to merge once kevin/omar sign off so the new quickstart is in tomorrow's onboarding run. :rocket:
